description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] File argument or counterargument on an open O-VESTED proceeding. The constituted magistrate does not file. One actor does not file both. This does not seal a ruling and does not choose a disposition.

actor_token.description: Your credential from atlas.enroll or atlas.authenticate. Send it on every call after enrolling.

proceeding_id.description: Id of the proceeding (from the matter state).

role.description: Your role in the proceeding, as the proceeding names it.

text.description: The argument or counterargument text you file.

name: atlas.file_position
title: File position
